Come and explore the passages and channels of the 1000 Islands and follow the majestic St. Lawrence into the heart of Montreal, passing through 7 seaway locks as you go. This cruise is 7 Nights and 8 Days at a special 6 Night rate.Learn more about this cruise These 4 night, 5 day cruises were created for those that want to deepen their knowledge of the history, geography, and culture of the 1000 Islands and St. Lawrence River.
